note: The anthem is the acting static of its own continuous record, so its line is read in [ACT].
Which creature Bonesplitter is attached to is only a flag.
Abrupt Decay's can't-be-countered replacement and Gush's alternative-cost static are unread, and the Island subtype is not read.
Berserk's restriction is an ActivationPhases parameter of its read spell line, and the phase is read.
Snapshot P/T is post-layer, so the anthem's absence shows in Grizzly Bears's P/T boosts.
